_comment: Tier-2 numerical-comparison fixture (NOT an exception class). Backward / Crank-Nicolson at the same dt stays bounded. The Signal a post-execution critic should match is the magnitude RATIO between observed and analytical solution — not an exception string. Verifies the heat-equation pitfall: 'forward Euler with too-large dt produces oscillating solution that grows exponentially'.
